description: One index reading for one block at one moment — NDVI, NDRE, moisture. This is the record that makes a satellite pull worth keeping: the imagery itself is re-downloadable and expensive, the number derived from it is small and permanent, and a season of these is what the anomaly detector compares against. Written by a pull, never by hand.

fields.description: The block this reading is of. A metric with no block is a number with no ground.
fields.label: Block

fields.description: Copied from the block on save, and kept. A block sold in July must not retroactively move June's readings to the buyer's books.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: Which vegetation index. NDVI is the one Field.last_ndvi_mean mirrors; the rest live only here.
fields.label: Index
fields.options:
ndvi
evi
ndre
ndwi
ndmi
savi

fields.description: When the satellite passed, NOT when the row was written. A backfill run in August writes rows stamped with May.
fields.label: Acquired At

fields.description: The index in its own physical units — NDVI runs -1 to 1 and water reads negative. This is what an agronomist reads.
fields.label: Raw Value

fields.description: The same reading rescaled 0-100, derived on save. What the anomaly detector compares, because a relative drop computed on raw NDVI is unsound near zero.
fields.label: Indexed 0-100

fields.description: The provider and collection this came from — 'sentinel-2-l2a', 'copernicus'. Two sources are not comparable pixel for pixel.
fields.label: Source

fields.description: Cloud fraction of the pass this came from. A cloudy pass reads as a low NDVI and looks exactly like a crop in trouble, so the figure travels with the number.
fields.label: Cloud Cover

fields.description: Set when the reading is for one hex within the block rather than the whole of it. Blank means the whole block.
fields.label: H3 Cell

fields.description: How many pixels the mean was taken over, after masking. A mean over eleven pixels is not the same claim as one over forty thousand.
fields.label: Usable Pixels

fields.description: Spread across the block. A high one on a healthy mean is a block that is half fine and half not.
fields.label: Std Dev

name: Satellite Metric
